definition: Appointment scheduling software lets a business take, manage and confirm bookings online instead of by phone or paper. For service businesses such as spas, salons and clinics it also assigns the staff member and room for each booking and prevents overlaps.
aka: appointment booking software, scheduling software, booking app

definition: Multi-branch booking software manages bookings, staff, rooms and revenue for a business with more than one location in a single system. Owners see every branch at once, and staff can be scheduled to transfer between branches.
aka: multi-location booking software, multi-site booking software, multi-outlet booking software

definition: A double booking happens when the same staff member, room or time slot is booked for two customers at once. Zennly refuses conflicting bookings at database level, so a double booking cannot be saved, even across branches.
aka: overbooking, scheduling conflict

definition: Daily reconciliation is the end-of-day check that recorded payments match the money actually received, by method (cash, card, online). When each payment is recorded against its booking at the point of service, the daily close is a read rather than a rebuild.
aka: end-of-day reconciliation, daily cash-up, till reconciliation, daily close

definition: A discount approval workflow requires staff to request a discount and a manager to approve it before it applies. Every request and decision is logged, which prevents untracked discounts and revenue leakage.
aka: discount authorization, discount authorisation, manager approval for discounts

definition: An audit trail is a permanent record of who did what and when, such as who requested and approved a discount. It lets owners review decisions after the fact without relying on memory.
relatedLabel: Discount approval with an audit trail
aka: audit log, activity log

definition: Role-based access control limits what each person can see and do according to their job. In Zennly, owners, managers and front-desk staff each get a different level of access to bookings, payments and reports.
aka: RBAC, staff permissions, user permissions

definition: A part-payment is a partial payment toward a booking, such as a deposit paid up front with the balance settled later. Tracking each part-payment against the booking keeps the settlement status accurate.
aka: partial payment, deposit and balance, split payment

definition: A staff transfer schedules an employee to work at a different branch on given days. In a multi-branch system the transfer is planned ahead so the staff member's availability is correct at both locations.
aka: employee transfer between locations, cross-location staffing

definition: A no-show is a client who books an appointment and does not turn up or cancel. For service businesses it means an empty slot that cannot be resold, which is why many studios and clinics take a deposit or send confirmations.
relatedLabel: Booking software for spas and salons
aka: missed appointment, did not attend (DNA)

definition: A deposit is a part-payment taken when a booking is made, to hold the slot. It is recorded against the booking, and the balance is recorded when the service is complete. Deposits are common in tattoo studios and for long treatments.
aka: booking deposit, advance payment, prepayment

definition: Booking software lets a business take appointments online and manage them in one calendar. Spas, salons, gyms and clinics use it to replace phone calls and paper books, assign staff and rooms, and track payments per booking.
relatedLabel: How to choose booking software in Nepal
aka: online booking software, reservation software

definition: The booking lifecycle is the set of stages a booking moves through, such as Pending, Confirmed, In-Progress and Completed. Tracking the stage of every booking shows the owner what is happening across all branches in real time.
aka: appointment status workflow, booking status

definition: An online booking system lets customers choose a service, staff member and time on a web page or phone, and holds the slot straight away. For businesses it replaces phone and chat bookings with one calendar that other staff and branches can see.
aka: online appointment booking, web booking, self-booking

definition: Spa management software combines online booking, therapist and room scheduling, payments and reporting for a spa or wellness centre. Multi-location spas also need one view of every site, so owners can compare bookings and revenue.
relatedLabel: Spa management software: how to choose
aka: spa booking software, wellness center software, wellness centre software

definition: Salon management software handles bookings, stylist schedules, payments and reports for a hair or beauty salon. For salons with several branches it also shows every location in one place and controls discounts.
relatedLabel: Salon management software: how to choose
aka: salon booking software, hair salon software, beauty parlour software

definition: Resource scheduling means booking everything a service needs together, such as the staff member, the room and the time, so that none of them is double-booked. It matters most when a treatment needs both a person and a room.
aka: staff and room scheduling, resource booking

definition: A walk-in booking is an appointment entered for a customer who arrives without booking in advance. Entering it in the same calendar as online bookings keeps staff and rooms from being promised twice.
aka: walk-in appointment, drop-in booking

definition: Beauty parlour software is booking and management software for beauty parlours, the common Nepali name for a salon. It takes appointments online, schedules beauticians, tracks packages and discounts, and records payments.
aka: parlour software, parlour management system, salon software Nepal

definition: Gym management software tracks memberships, renewals, classes and trainers for a gym or fitness studio. It shows who has paid, who has lapsed and how many sessions remain.
aka: gym software, fitness studio software, gym membership software

definition: Membership management software tracks prepaid tiers, wallet balances, validity periods and renewals. Every deposit and deduction is recorded so the balance is always correct.
aka: prepaid membership software, wallet balance software

definition: A session package is a bundle of sessions for one service sold at a set price, such as ten massages. Each visit redeems one session, and the record shows sessions left and any amount due.
aka: treatment package, service bundle

definition: A gift voucher is a prepaid value with a unique code and an expiry date that a customer redeems as payment, in one visit or over several. It differs from a discount code because it holds money.
aka: prepaid voucher, gift card

definition: Staff commission is extra pay calculated as a percentage of the value of the services a therapist, stylist or trainer completed. It is usually paid on top of a base salary.
relatedLabel: How to calculate commission and payroll
aka: therapist commission, commission calculation

definition: A win-back email is a message sent to a customer who has not visited for a set number of days, inviting them to return. It is a low-cost way to recover lapsed regulars.
aka: lapsed customer email, re-engagement email

definition: Multi-branch spa management means running several spa locations from one system, with shared staff, one set of rules for discounts and one daily report across branches.
aka: multi-location spa software, spa chain software

definition: Clinic appointment software schedules practitioners and rooms together, keeps repeat treatments with the same practitioner and records payments per visit. It is not a medical records system.
aka: physiotherapy appointment software, clinic scheduling software

definition: A beauty parlour is the common name in Nepal and South Asia for a salon offering hair, skin, nails, threading, waxing and bridal makeup services.
aka: parlor, beauty salon, ladies parlour

definition: An AI receptionist is an AI assistant that answers customer calls and chat messages for a business and helps them book, so enquiries are not missed when staff are busy or the shop is closed.
aka: AI booking assistant, AI phone assistant, chatbot for bookings
